jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists/activists with regional expertise, not a recent graduate, and reads as a voluntary/advisory position with no vacancy for the candidate. The human-rights and securitisation subject is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.
